remarks: Bring your vision to life with this partially renovated property situated on 7th Street in Niagara Falls! Much of the renovation work has already been completed, providing a great starting point for buyers looking to add their finishing touches. The downstairs kitchen and bathroom are among the primary areas awaiting completion, and the majority of the materials needed to finish the remaining projects are already on-site and included in the sale, helping to reduce additional renovation expenses. The upstairs has been configured as an in-law-style suite, creating flexible living arrangements for extended family, guests, or additional household needs. Conveniently located near downtown Niagara Falls, this property provides easy access to local restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and popular destinations such as Niagara Falls State Park, the Aquarium of Niagara, and scenic Niagara Gorge trails. With renovations already underway, materials included, and a versatile interior layout, this property presents an exciting opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant ready to complete the improvements and make it their own!
